transcript.content: Hello, and welcome. I'm Dr. [Name], a psychiatrist. What brings you in to see me today?

Yeah, hi. I guess I came in because... well, ever since I moved into this new place—it's just this busted-up room, really—things have just been a mess. I’m snapping at people all the time. I end up staying up half the night trying to fix leaks or get the heat working, and then... I'm just dragging myself to work late. And once I'm there, I'm messing up stuff on the site that I normally handle no problem. It's just catching up to me, I guess.
Before you moved into this new place, were you having problems like irritability, sleep issues, or trouble concentrating at work?

No, not at all. I was doing pretty normal before I moved in. Honestly, all this stuff... the snapping at people, the bad sleep, messing up at work... it all started within the first couple weeks of being there and finding all the water damage and realizing the heat didn't work right. Before that, things were fine.
Are you still experiencing these problems—the irritability, sleep issues, and trouble at work—right now, or have things gotten better since you moved in?

No, things haven't gotten any better because... well, I'm still living in it. The housing mess hasn't ended. I'm still in that room, still fighting with the landlord about getting things fixed, still trying to patch up leaks myself. So, yeah, the irritability and the sleep stuff... it's all still happening right now, just because the problem itself is still happening, you know? It's not like the place got fixed and I'm still acting this way.
Do you have any sense of when the landlord might get these repairs done, or is this something that could go on for months?

I don't really know, honestly. Every time I ask him, he just brushes me off or says he'll send someone next week, but nobody ever shows up. So, yeah, it feels like it could just keep going on for months if I can't figure out a way to force his hand or find somewhere else to go.
How long has it been since you moved into this place and started experiencing all these problems—the irritability, sleep issues, and trouble at work?
It's been going on for about a month now. I'd say it all started shortly after I moved into that room in Bridgeport.

If your landlord finally fixed all these problems with the heat and the leaks, do you think your irritability and sleep problems would go away pretty quickly, or do you think they might stick around for a while even after the apartment is fixed?

I think they'd go away pretty quick, honestly. If I actually had heat and a dry room, I could finally sleep, you know? 

But... well, the housing mess hasn't really ended yet. I'm still in that room, still dealing with the repairs and the landlord every single day. So it's not like this is something that has kept going long after the problem was over. The problem is still right in front of me. But yeah, if he actually fixed it all tomorrow, I really think I'd get back to normal pretty fast.

Let me ask this a different way: imagine you moved out of that room tomorrow and found a safe place with heat and no leaks. How long do you think it would take before your irritability and sleep problems actually went away—would it be days, or would it take weeks or longer even after you're out of that situation?

I mean, if I could just get out of there tomorrow and into a normal place? I think it would only take a few days, maybe a week tops. Once I know I'm warm and not getting dripped on, I'd finally be able to sleep. And once I'm sleeping, I know I wouldn't be snapping at everyone at work. So yeah, I think it would clear up real quick once I'm out of there.
